verdict.rationale: SigNoz doesn't natively generate incident summaries, but it exposes an MCP server so external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) can query alerts/traces/logs/metrics in natural language, and documents use-cases like 'Investigate What Changed After a Deploy' and 'Tune a Noisy Alert' that resemble AI-assisted incident context gathering. This relies on connecting a third-party AI agent rather than a built-in summarization feature purpose-built for responders. Missing for 10: a native, first-party 'incident summary' or alert-context generator inside the SigNoz UI, and independent evidence of responders actually using this for real incidents.
